gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: The TRAIN diagnostic used four grayscale frames and exact-hash fixed checkpoints, but a submission package and official platform validation have not been completed.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: The envelope changed gas in 140 and 135 decisions on the two registered TRAIN cells; mean gas rose from 0.093/0.095 to 0.152/0.155. Both arms completed both cells with no invalid actions.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: The candidate was 1.46 and 1.08 seconds faster on the two paired consumed TRAIN cells, but no fresh tune, held-out, or package comparison has been conducted. TRAIN diagnostics do not establish candidate performance.
